2609.29269.title: ALOE: Semantically Addressed Low-Rank Operators for Knowledge Editing
2609.29269.paper_summary: Knowledge editing changes what a model knows by modifying parameters so that a requested fact updates while unrelated behavior is preserved. This is usually treated as a write problem, but editing also involves an address problem: deciding which hidden states should receive the new residual. An update that activates too narrowly memorizes one prompt, while one that activates too broadly disrupts neighboring knowledge. Parametric editors encode this scope implicitly, whereas memory-based editors make the selection explicit but keep it outside the edited model. We propose ALOE (Addressed Low-rank Operator for Editing), which learns semantic addresses from paraphrases and hard same-subject negatives, aligns them with autoregressive hidden states through rollout refinement and gate calibration, and embeds the resulting gated low-rank operator within one MLP layer, so that the deployed model runs in a single forward pass with no external retriever or auxiliary router. Evaluated on CounterFact, ZSRE, and KnowEdit across three 7--8B model families, ALOE achieves efficacy between 0.955 and 0.999 and locality between 0.981 and 1.000; mechanistic analyses confirm that the learned geometry separates competing edits and that calibration suppresses out-of-scope activation. The remaining errors concentrate in paraphrase coverage and write fitting.
2609.29269.paper_summary_zh: 知識編輯透過修改參數來改變模型所知道的內容，以便在更新請求的事實時保留不相關的行為。這通常被視為寫入問題，但編輯也涉及一個地址問題：決定哪些隱藏狀態應該接收新的殘差。過於狹隘的激活會記住一個提示，而過於廣泛的激活則會干擾相鄰的知識。參數編輯器隱式編碼這個範圍，而基於記憶的編輯器則明確選擇，但將其保持在編輯模型之外。我們提出了ALOE（針對編輯的地址低秩運算子），它從同義句和困難的相同主題負樣本中學習語義地址，通過展開細化和閘校準將其與自回歸隱藏狀態對齊，並將結果的閘低秩運算子嵌入一個MLP層中，以便部署的模型在單次前向傳遞中運行，無需外部檢索器或輔助路由器。在CounterFact、ZSRE和KnowEdit上對三個7--8B模型系列進行評估，ALOE的效能介於0.955和0.999之間，局部性介於0.981和1.000之間；機械分析確認所學幾何分離了競爭編輯，並且校準抑制了超出範圍的激活。剩餘的錯誤集中在同義句覆蓋和寫入擬合上。
